overview: Sales Dashboard is a local Node.js web app for scheduled CSV/XLSX sales-call transcript exports. It profiles import quality, deduplicates calls, runs deterministic local transcript evaluation, parks optional campaign/allocation imports outside active analytics, optionally submits local model jobs through the AI Execution Layer, persists derived local history, and renders a manager-facing dashboard without using unsupported phone/date, sales, or revenue assumptions.
objective: Surface contact quality, meaningful conversations, follow-up signals, lead reattempt behaviour, lead harvest candidates, call-CSV source/list quality, manager review queues, import history, and generated reports while preserving privacy and data-confidence boundaries. Preserve separate campaign/allocation data only as parked diagnostics and untrusted legacy disposition/note fields only in raw source storage.

steps: Start with node src/main.js --csv "C:\Users\User\Downloads\July 1 Data.csv" or set SALES_DASHBOARD_CSV_PATH.
Optionally provide --allocations <path> or SALES_DASHBOARD_ALLOCATIONS_PATH for a parked allocation CSV/XLSX diagnostic.
Parse CSV/XLSX first-sheet tabular inputs with src/sourceFile.js, src/csvParser.js, and src/xlsxReader.js.
Deduplicate calls by call_id, ignore privacy-reduced fields for analytics, and parse valid customer import/create dates only for source-quality Record Age.
Evaluate each transcript locally with deterministic rules in src/transcriptEvaluator.js.
Link follow-up signals through stable source IDs only; record a later exact-ID attempt without claiming callback completion, payment, or sale completion.

Build active call/transcript metrics, deterministic one-dial lead reattempt buckets, lead harvest candidates, an isolated long-held-record/import attribution audit, a separate weekly-report supply snapshot, parked allocation status, alerts, sanitized evaluation rows, and explorer rows in src/analysis.js.

Format all UI-facing dates and times through src/dateTimeFormat.js using Australian DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm:ss AEST display. Source call times are labelled as source call time in AEST without browser timezone conversion; system timestamps are converted to fixed AEST.
Apply shared global call/transcript filters with src/globalFilters.js for summary APIs, dashboard cards, alerts, drill-downs, and explorer rows.
Merge alert lifecycle state with generated call-data alerts using src/alertLifecycle.js.
Apply governed manager review overlays from src/managerReview.js and src/storage.js so review status, corrections, and history remain separate from raw/deterministic/LLM/alert evidence.

Manage Evaluation Studio knowledgebase entries, strict-schema templates with safe custom evaluation goals, Call Intelligence Foundation v6/schema v3, typed Callback/Procedure/Objection specialist contracts, authoritative Offer Acceptance, full-transcript input audit metadata, locally reconciled routing, bounded harvest, versioned results with provenance, report-safe rollups, and result-to-manager-review handoffs through the Evaluation Studio UI and APIs.

Build a read-only call_intelligence_aggregate.v1 projection that separates accepted-offer evidence, quoted context, intended payment timing, payment verification, invoice, fulfilment, revenue, and CRM state; resolves supported relative dates from Australian source dates; and exposes evaluator conflicts, specialist lifecycle states, strongest evidence, and claim provenance.

Persist derived import history, parked allocation metadata, evaluation artifacts, alert lifecycle history, manager review correction/history state, Evaluation Studio artifacts/results, and reports through src/storage.js.
Classify stored reports so normal report APIs and dashboard report lists expose active reports only while preserving parked/stale records internally.

Submit optional local model transcript jobs and explicit Evaluation Studio runs through src/aiExecutionLayer.js and C:\Users\User\Desktop\ai-execution-layer. Evaluation Studio jobs require the Execution Layer dynamic-schema-v1 contract and one active leased worker; /api/ai/status?health=true exposes sanitised worker state before a large batch.

Run the remaining Foundation backlog through the daily 22:00-06:00 Melbourne Windows task. Advance one 500-call Foundation parent and its recommended specialist runs per clean boundary; stop new parents at 04:30 and let the Execution Layer pause protected claims on user activity or low available memory.

Render shared-filter manager workspaces selected by view=overview|harvest|follow_up|reviews|team|intelligence|records through src/dashboardRenderer.js, while keeping Evaluation Studio at /evaluation-studio.

Keep historical Evaluation Studio knowledge visible for governance but exclude entries marked pending_manager_approval from new run snapshots and local model input until a manager explicitly marks them approved_current.

architecture: src/main.js: local HTTP server, health route, summary API, allocation API, and reload route
src/csvParser.js: CSV parsing boundary
src/sourceFile.js: CSV/XLSX source-file adapter
src/xlsxReader.js: minimal XLSX first-sheet reader using built-in Node modules
src/allocationCoverage.js: preserved allocation workbook parser, parked from active analytics
src/allocationParking.js: parked allocation diagnostic, stale report classification, and historical parked-data filtering helpers
src/globalFilters.js: shared active call/transcript filter state, option generation, missing-value buckets, and denominator summaries
src/alertLifecycle.js: alert status, active/closed count, server-resolved local actor, manager note, and lifecycle-history helpers
src/managerReview.js: manager review status/scope/correction allowlist, local actor resolution, correction overlay, and review-history helpers

src/evaluationStudio.js: Evaluation Studio knowledgebase/template/run/result model, Call Intelligence Foundation schema v3 with represented-party proof/repair, final-state and long-term-nurture reconciliation, shared Foundation call context, independent opportunity/measurement/efficiency lenses, locally reconciled specialist routing, strict transcript validation, Lead Record and Offer Acceptance validation, bounded batch harvesting, provenance, Foundation/specialist rollups, and guarded local-model input construction
src/callIntelligenceAggregate.js: versioned call-level commercial lifecycle, authority conflict, specialist state, provenance, exact-evidence, and Australian relative-date projection
src/dateTimeFormat.js: Australian/AEST UI date/time formatter for source call times, filters, reports, and stored system timestamps
src/transcriptEvaluator.js: local deterministic call evaluator

src/analysis.js: data profiling, active/filtered call-transcript metrics, deterministic lead reattempt buckets, lead harvest candidates, parked allocation status, alert construction, manager-review governance overlays, and sanitized rows
src/leadHarvestAnalytics.js: positive-response callback candidate queue with possible name/timing extraction and stable-ID later-call labels
src/selfSourcingAttribution.js: New Business long-held-record, historical-import, and salesperson-created attribution-review model; Crystal Reports are not an input dependency
src/weeklyLeadIntelligence.js: supplied weekly-report snapshot for lead supply, trend, and workflow catalogue; it remains separate from active call metrics and commercial attribution
src/storage.js: ignored local JSON store, import artifact writer, generated report saver, active report visibility view, alert lifecycle persistence, and manager review correction/history persistence
src/aiExecutionLayer.js: optional local AI Execution Layer client for transcript jobs and sanitised worker-health proxying

src/overnightEvaluationAutomation.js and scripts/run-overnight-evaluations.js: Melbourne-time backlog scheduling, clean-boundary quality gating, durable controller state, and one-parent-at-a-time Foundation/specialist progression

src/dashboardRenderer.js: HTML rendering and escaping layer, focused manager workspace navigation, and standalone Evaluation Studio presentation with separate readable knowledgebase/template libraries and expandable per-item editors
tests/analysis.test.js: parser, evaluator, parked allocation regression, and date-handling verification
tests/storage.test.js: persistence and report-library verification

guardrails.untrusted_legacy_fields: NoSaleType and Baz_DetailedNotes are optional raw-source-only legacy fields. They are excluded from active analytics, alerts, filters, reports, scorecards, UI/APIs, manager-review prefill, and AI/evaluator context.
unsupported_metrics: order value generated by a call
guardrails.phone_matching: Use stable source IDs only. Do not use partial phone values for matching or display.
guardrails.record_age: Source-quality Record Age uses valid CustomerImportDate first and valid CustomerCreateDate second. Malformed date fragments are treated as missing and raw date fields stay out of proof tables.
guardrails.self_sourcing_attribution: The Self-Sourcing Attribution Audit separates long-held records, confirmed historical imports, and salesperson-created records. It is attribution-review evidence only and cannot prove online discovery, neglect, sales/revenue ownership, or a reattribution decision. Crystal .rpt files are optional and unsupported.
guardrails.allocation_campaign_attribution: Campaign/allocation imports are parked and excluded from active metrics, reports, alerts, filters, source/list quality, scorecards, and AI transcript context.
guardrails.alert_lifecycle: Active alert counts include only new, acknowledged, and in_progress call-data alerts. Resolved, dismissed, false_positive, and parked alerts are excluded from active totals. Lifecycle actors are server-resolved as local_manager until authentication exists.
guardrails.manager_review: Manager review statuses and corrections are separate from alert lifecycle. Corrections are local_manager-attributed overlays and do not overwrite raw imported, deterministic, LLM, or generated alert evidence.
guardrails.evaluation_studio: Evaluation Studio artifacts are versioned management records. Foundation keeps opportunity, measurement eligibility, and efficiency independent; typed specialists remain authoritative for their questions. The call aggregate separates accepted offer from payment verification, invoice, fulfilment, revenue, and CRM state; unknowns remain unknown. Relative dates retain raw language and source-date policy. Later exact-ID calls prove only that a related attempt was observed. Inputs record complete app-source transcript length/hash and final-turn policy. Numeric model confidence is uncalibrated audit metadata. Neither Foundation nor Offer Acceptance proves payment, fulfilment, revenue, ROI, or CRM closure. Observed live latency still does not establish 10,000/day capacity.
guardrails.lead_reattempt: One-dial records are neutral until deterministic evidence separates valid one-dial outcomes, risky one-dial no-contact rows, and rows needing manager or later local-LLM review.
guardrails.lead_harvest: Lead harvest candidates require deterministic live-human, positive-response, and callback/follow-up evidence. Later-call labels use stable IDs only; missing stable IDs are labelled matching unavailable.
guardrails.report_visibility: Normal report APIs and dashboard report lists expose active non-parked reports only. Parked allocation, stale stable-target, and superseded lead-day report records remain preserved internally.
